AXOM AUTOMATED BETA AUDIT QUESTION SET

1. A 24-year-old healthy adult has a resting heart rate of 70 beats per minute. Which structure normally initiates each heartbeat?

A. Atrioventricular node
B. Bundle of His
C. Purkinje fibers
D. Sinoatrial node

Correct Answer: D

Explanation:
The sinoatrial node is the normal pacemaker of the heart and initiates atrial depolarization.

2. Which epidemiologic measure compares the probability of an outcome in an exposed group with the probability in an unexposed group?

A. Odds ratio
B. Relative risk
C. Prevalence
D. Specificity

Correct Answer: B

Explanation:
Relative risk is the incidence or risk in the exposed group divided by the incidence or risk in the unexposed group.

3. A highly sensitive screening test is especially useful when a negative result helps rule out disease. Which mnemonic describes this principle?

A. SpPin
B. SnNout
C. PPVin
D. NPVout

Correct Answer: B

Explanation:
SnNout means a highly sensitive test, when negative, helps rule out disease.
